text: You take three GLASS SHARDS in quick succession and duck for cover.
Your SYLLADEX rains devastation on your room from above.
And now that your cards are packed with glass, you probably don't want to do that again any time soon.
alt: You quickly captchalogue three of the shards of glass, launching the BOOK, CAKE, and TRICK HANDCUFFS. John narrowly avoids them.
